title: Obtain crystal structure of Mn₂(CO)₁₀ (room temperature)
action: Retrieve the atomic coordinates, unit cell parameters, and space group for room-temperature Mn₂(CO)₁₀ from the Cambridge Structural Database (CSD) using refcode MNCO10. Save the structure as a CIF file for later steps.
description: Required data preparation step to obtain the experimental crystal structure for Mn₂(CO)₁₀.

title: Obtain crystal structure of Fe₃(CO)₁₂ (room temperature)
action: Retrieve the atomic coordinates, unit cell parameters, and space group for room-temperature Fe₃(CO)₁₂ from the Cambridge Structural Database (CSD) using refcode FECARB. Save the structure as a CIF file for later steps.
description: Required data preparation step to obtain the experimental crystal structure for Fe₃(CO)₁₂.

title: Compute intramolecular non-bonded energies (IAM) for Mn₂(CO)₁₀ and Fe₃(CO)₁₂
action: Using the room-temperature structures from Steps 1 and 2, implement the Buckingham pair potential sum over atom pairs: A*exp(-B*r) - C*r^{-6} with the atom-pair parameters for O-O, O-C, C-C, and Kr-Kr/Kr-O as reported in the paper (A in kcal/mol, B in Å^{-1}, C in kcal/mol). For each cluster, compute all intra-reference-molecule non-bonded atom–atom pairs, excluding nearest-neighbour 1–3 contacts. Partition the total into O–O, O–C, C–C repulsive, C–C attractive, and M–O contributions (using Kr as proxy for Mn/Fe) and output these five values in kcal/mol to a CSV file with one row per cluster.
description: CSV file with rows for Mn₂(CO)₁₀ and Fe₃(CO)₁₂, each containing partitioned intramolecular energies.
output_schema: Columns: cluster (string), OO, OC, CC_rep, CC_attr, MO (all floats, kcal/mol).

title: Compute intermolecular packing energy (IEM) for Mn₂(CO)₁₀ and Fe₃(CO)₁₂
action: Using the same Buckingham potential and the crystal structures, for each cluster generate all symmetry-equivalent molecules in the unit cell. Sum the intermolecular atom–atom interactions between a chosen reference molecule and all surrounding molecules whose atoms lie within a 10 Å cutoff of the reference molecule. Output the total intermolecular energy in kcal/mol for each cluster as one row in a CSV file.
description: CSV file with rows for Mn₂(CO)₁₀ and Fe₃(CO)₁₂, each containing the total intermolecular packing energy.
